title: The Observer Ascends the Throne
next_chapter_hook: "Just as the ministers knelt in reverence, a faint cold laugh echoed from the dragon throne—it was Zhang Wudi suppressing his fury, his voice low: 'Observer... I shall see just how much of the Heavenly Secrets you can truly observe.'"

text.content:
The Grand Hall of the Imperial Capital, eighty-one golden pillars carved with coiling dragons rose into the clouds, each inscribed with the illustrious names of past emperors. The crimson carpet wound from the hall doors to the foot of the dragon throne, armored guards standing in ranks on either side, their cold armor reflecting the giant celestial orb on the dome above—a replica of the sun and moon.

The air was thick with sandalwood mingling with tension—this day was unlike any other. All the civil and military officials knew that Chen Ji, once despised as 'waste' in the cultivation world, had arrived as the 'Observer' to announce a new order to the entire continent.

The hall doors opened wide, a figure silhouetted against the light.

Chen Ji wore plain white robes, his garments rippling without wind, surrounded by faint starlight. His eyes were no longer ordinary black and white—golden and silver-white patterns swirled within his pupils, the unique 'Heavenly Eye' form when the Tianji Record was fully activated.

With one step into the hall, his oppressive aura poured forth like a tangible force. The two nearest guards grunted, knees going weak, nearly falling to the ground.

dialogue.content:
Everyone... I've kept you waiting.

Chen Ji's voice was not loud, yet it reached every ear clearly. He walked forward slowly, each step seeming to tread on the hearts of the ministers. His gaze swept across those faces—some terrified, some furious, some desperately maintaining composure—his lips curving slightly upward.

What, seeing me and forgetting your manners?

text.content:
A pin dropping could be heard in the grand hall.

Those civil and military officials who usually commanded the court now dared not meet that white-robed figure's gaze. Some secretly lowered their heads, some had legs trembling, and some quietly reached for transmission jade tokens hidden in their sleeves—the hidden operatives the old sects had planted in the hall.

Chen Ji observed all of this; nothing was hidden from his Heavenly Eye.

At the hall entrance, two figures followed closely behind.

Su Qingyao wore cyan robes, a sword on her back, her face frost-cold. Her gaze remained fixed on Chen Ji's back, fingertips gently resting on her sword hilt—a stance ready to strike at any moment.

Ye Qing wore black纱, hidden in the shadows, purple eyes surveying all the startled prey with playful amusement. As the Holy Sect's Saint, she understood best the fear churning in these people's hearts.

Chen Ji didn't stop, having reached the hall's center.

dialogue.content:
Raise your heads.

Chen Ji's voice remained calm but carried undeniable pressure. He named no one, yet his gaze fell upon the highest point in the hall—the area beside the dragon throne, behind the sun-moon fan screen symbolizing imperial power.

I came in person today not to hear you begging on your knees.

His finger lifted slightly, and the sun-moon fan screen slowly parted on its own, revealing the figure seated upon the dragon throne.

text.content:
The entire hall erupted in chaos.

The figure was finally revealed—Zhang Wudi, the nominal ruler of the world, holding the Central Earth Imperial Dynasty's centuries-old foundation. He appeared around forty, features resolute, tiger eyes fixed死死 on Chen Ji, complex emotions churning beneath: shock, fury, and... a carefully hidden trace of apprehension.

I... have not been 'invited' out like this in many years.

Zhang Wudi's voice was low, each word seeming to be forced through clenched teeth. He rose slowly, the five-clawed golden dragon embroidered on his dragon robes seeming to come alive, radiating faint imperial pressure that clashed distantly with Chen Ji's Observer pressure.

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao stepped forward, standing shoulder to shoulder with Chen Ji.

She said nothing, but her presence itself was a declaration—the Inner Sect Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect, the pinnacle of the younger generation among the three great sects, now standing beside the 'waste' Chen Ji.

This scene, witnessed by all the court officials, was even more shocking.

Chen Ji met Zhang Wudi's gaze, the patterns in his Heavenly Eye swirling deeper.

There's no need for Your Majesty to be angry. I came today for only two things—

He raised one finger.

First, to announce the new order: from this day forward, the Observer's Hall shall become the supreme court of judgment for all cultivators in the world. Immortal sects, secular dynasties—all fall within the scope of observation.

He raised a second finger.

Second, to give Your Majesty a choice.

text.content:
The hall's atmosphere froze to its limit.

Zhang Wudi stared at Chen Ji, imperial pressure surging like angry tides, yet it struck an invisible wall, unable to shake Chen Ji in the slightest. His heart churned—what kind of power was this? His cultivation appeared only at Golden Core realm, yet he could emit pressure even the old monsters at Nascent Soul stage never possessed?

In the hall's shadows, several gazes exchanged glances. Those hidden operatives from old sects had already begun connecting through divine sense, waiting—for the emperor's command to launch a lethal strike.

choice.prompt: The pressure has reached its peak, and both the emperor and old forces are testing your bottom line. How do you intend to face this first collision between new order and old imperial power?

choices.description: Directly release the full Heavenly Eye pressure, crushing the emperor's resistance with absolute force and forcing him to kneel before everyone.
choices.visible_reward: The emperor kneels in surrender, Reputation +15, old forces intimidated
choices.risk_hint: Excessive pressure may provoke the old forces into desperate counterattack, triggering chaos

text.content:
Chen Ji spoke no more.

He only gently widened his Heavenly Eye—in that instant, the light throughout the entire hall seemed distorted. Golden and silver-white patterns spun madly within his pupils, an indescribable pressure pouring down like mountains collapsing and seas turning.

dialogue.content:
Kneel.

Just one word, yet heavy as a thousand catties.

Zhang Wudi's face instantly turned ashen. His legs seemed bound by invisible force, knees bending involuntarily. The imperial body, at this moment, was actually lowering itself!

"Impossible—!"

He roared, true essence within him surging wildly, trying to break free from that pressure. But all was futile.

choices.memory_label: 陈机以绝对力量当众压服皇帝，展现观测者之威

choices.description: Gather the pressure, display strength but don't humiliate the emperor. Give Zhang Wudi a dignified step down and see how he chooses.
choices.visible_reward: The emperor is forced to acknowledge the Observer's status, Reputation +10, preserving room for negotiation
choices.risk_hint: The emperor may use this chance to counterattack and propose treacherous conditions

text.content:
Chen Ji recalled part of his pressure, but the Heavenly Eye remained fully open, golden and silver-white patterns swirling endlessly in his pupils' depths.

He said nothing, only watching Zhang Wudi quietly.

That silence was more devastating than any words—it meant 'I could make you kneel, but I choose to let you stand yourself.' Such居高临下的 leniency was, for an emperor, an even greater humiliation.

dialogue.content:
I do not appreciate coercion.

Chen Ji finally spoke, his voice still calm.

Your Majesty is a wise man and should understand the meaning of 'a wise person knows when to yield.' Two of the three great sects have already submitted their letters of allegiance to the Observer's Hall, and Han Lie, the first genius of Xuanwu Sect...

He paused meaningfully.

Has also experienced my methods. If Your Majesty wishes to follow in his footsteps, I shall accommodate you today.

choices.memory_label: 陈机展示实力但不羞辱皇帝，展现成熟政治智慧

choices.description: Without relying on pressure, demonstrate a specific ability of the Heavenly Eye on the spot, letting everyone witness the terrifying nature of the Observer.
choices.visible_reward: The emperor and ministers witness the Tianji Record's might firsthand, Reputation +12, Su Qingyao Affection +5
choices.risk_hint: Prematurely revealing ability details may allow schemers to memorize weaknesses

text.content:
Chen Ji smiled faintly.

Since Your Majesty wishes to witness, I shall make it clear.

He waved his hand, the Heavenly Eye suddenly brightening. A illusory light screen rose from his fingertips, projecting onto the hall's dome. Countless images appeared in the screen—everything that had happened in this hall over the past three hours.

dialogue.content:
Everyone, please observe—

Chen Ji pointed to a corner in the screen. Three civil officials stood there, quietly communicating through divine sense.

These three are respectively operatives from Qingyun Sect, Xuanming Valley, and... White Heron Academy. Three quarters of an hour ago, they just received orders: if His Majesty shows any sign of defiance, activate the 'Heaven-Cleaving Talisman Formation' buried beneath the golden hall.

The three officials' faces instantly turned deathly pale.

choices.memory_label: 陈机展示天眼预知能力，当众揭露暗桩，消除潜在威胁

text.content:
Chen Ji's demonstration threw the entire hall into dead silence.

The three named officials' faces were ashen, collapsing to the ground. They never imagined their carefully hidden identities would be exposed publicly before everyone's eyes.

Zhang Wudi's expression darkened to the extreme. He glanced at the three operatives, then at the unruffled Chen Ji, throat bobbing, yet ultimately spoke no words.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji withdrew the screen, standing with hands behind his back.

Allow me to give Your Majesty another piece of advice—

His gaze swept across a certain shadow in the hall, lips curving slightly.

That friend hiding behind the third pillar on the east corridor, and the Immortal-Slaying Needle in the Southern Gate Guard Captain's possession... I suggest you don't move. Because within my Heavenly Eye, every thought in your minds is already crystal clear.

Another stir ran through the hall, but quickly subsided. Those who had been restless all chose to remain still.

text.content:
Zhang Wudi remained silent for a long while.

Finally, he slowly sat back on the dragon throne, those tiger eyes still fixed on Chen Ji, though the fighting spirit had faded considerably.

What an Observer indeed...

His voice was hoarse, carrying suppressed fury and reluctance.

I... concede. But I have one condition—if the Observer's Hall wishes to command the world, it must give the world an explanation. This dynasty is willing to submit, but His Majesty must personally attend next month's 'Heavenly Secrets Assembly' and, before the eyes of the world, receive your official appointment.

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing's voice sounded in Chen Ji's mind, tinged with vigilance:

Be careful. That old fox agreed too readily—he must be planning something. The 'Heavenly Secrets Assembly'... that place runs deep, with all factions gathered. He probably wants to set a trap for you publicly there.

Chen Ji didn't respond to Ye Qing, but a faint flicker appeared in his Heavenly Eye's depths—he had already glimpsed certain blurry images.

Su Qingyao stepped forward, standing shoulder to shoulder with Chen Ji.

She said nothing, but her gaze carried obvious worry. She knew what the 'Heavenly Secrets Assembly' meant—a grand gathering hosted by the three great sects, superficially for friendly exchange, but actually a battlefield where various powers vied for advantage.

If Chen Ji appeared there as the 'Observer,' he would become the target of all.

choice.prompt: The emperor proposes having Chen Ji attend the 'Heavenly Secrets Assembly,' superficially submitting but hiding deadly intent. Faced with this potentially dangerous invitation, how will you respond?

choices.description: Since the emperor dug a trap himself, turn the tables—let him think he's succeeded while secretly laying out your own plans.
choices.visible_reward: The emperor lowers his guard, gaining time to arrange strategy for the assembly
choices.risk_hint: If the plan fails, you'll be at a disadvantage at the assembly

dialogue.content:
Very well.

Chen Ji agreed without hesitation, even wearing a faint, meaningful smile.

Your Majesty's proposal is excellent. I was just planning to use the assembly to announce the new order's arrival to the world. Since Your Majesty is so cooperative, I shall accept graciously.

A flash of surprise crossed Zhang Wudi's eyes, quickly hidden. He thought Chen Ji had fallen into his trap, unaware that the other party had seen through everything long ago.

choices.memory_label: 陈机将计就计，接受皇帝邀请

choices.description: Immediately propose additional conditions: the emperor must first hand over the disposal rights of those three operatives as sincerity for attending.
choices.visible_reward: Gain substantial power, humiliate the emperor publicly, intimidate the old forces
choices.risk_hint: The emperor may turn hostile on the spot

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji nodded, then changed direction.

However, since Your Majesty is sincerely submitting, you should show some sincerity.

He pointed to the three collapsed operatives on the ground.

These three, I'll be taking them. As for how to handle them... that's my decision. No objections, I hope?

Zhang Wudi's face instantly turned ashen. These three operatives were chess pieces he had spent decades planting in the old sects, each with great utility. Being taken by Chen Ji in one sentence was equivalent to a public humiliation.

choices.memory_label: 陈机当场向皇帝索要暗桩处置权，彰显主导权

choices.description: With the posture of 'the Observer deigns not to compete with mortals,' decline the assembly and steadily plan from the imperial capital as your base.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain a low profile, buying more time to arrange strategy
choices.risk_hint: The old forces may seize the chance to counterattack

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji deliberated briefly, then shook his head.

The matter of the assembly... allow me to consider.

His voice remained flat, but the refusal within it caused a glint to flash in Zhang Wudi's eyes.

I am the Observer and dislike mortal social niceties. Your Majesty's sincerity has been noted. As for the assembly... when the time is right, I shall appear of my own accord.

This speech seemed modest on the surface, yet concealed needles within—he neither agreed nor refused, keeping the initiative firmly in his own hands.

choices.memory_label: 陈机以观测者姿态婉拒大会邀请，保持神秘与主动

text.content:
Chen Ji made his choice.

The hall's atmosphere shifted subtly. Zhang Wudi stared at him for a long moment before finally speaking:

Very well. The Observer is indeed extraordinary.

His voice revealed nothing of pleasure or anger, yet the undercurrents churning in those tiger eyes were apparent to all.

Very well, I shall await the Observer's good news. Guards—

He waved his hand, and several eunuchs rushed forward, lifting the three collapsed operatives.

These individuals... how does the Observer wish to handle them?

dialogue.content:
Kill them.

Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm.

Since they chose the wrong side, they must bear the consequences. I dislike leaving loose ends.

The three operatives' faces changed dramatically, begging frantically. But Chen Ji's gaze didn't even pause on them, only saying flatly:

Take them away. Don't dirty His Majesty's golden hall.

Ye Qing's figure flashed from the shadows, a wave of her slender hand, and a layer of purple-black demonic mist enveloped the three men, who vanished from the hall in an instant.

text.content:
The entire hall erupted.

The emperor's guards wanted to intervene but were stopped by Zhang Wudi's raised hand. He stared at Chen Ji, fury in his eyes nearly overflowing, yet ultimately suppressed it.

I... shall remember this day.

The words were forced through clenched teeth. A堂堂 emperor, in his own hall, watching helplessly as three trusted subordinates were seized and taken away—what manner of humiliation was this.

But he had no choice. It wasn't that he didn't want to resist, but... he dared not.

The composure and pressure Chen Ji had just displayed made him clearly realize: this seemingly young 'Observer' possessed the power to destroy the entire dynasty at any moment.

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao stood beside Chen Ji, her heart churning with complex emotions.

She watched that white-robed back, watching him subdue the entire dynasty single-handedly, an indescribable emotion rising within her. This man once called 'waste' in the sect now ruled the world in a way she had never imagined.

Her gaze fell upon the fragment in Chen Ji's grasp, her heart tightening slightly—with this intensity of Tianji Record usage, how much longer could he hold on?

text.content: Chen Ji turned and walked toward the hall
